rows.jyutping: daai6 go3 zo2 m4 zoi3 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone has matured beyond a habit, interest, need, or belief.

example.english: As I grow older, I outgrow my interest in building model kits.
example.traditional: 我大個咗唔再鍾意砌模型喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 go3 zo2 m4 zoi3 zung1 ji3 cai3 mou4 jing4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone has become too big for clothes, shoes, or another wearable item.

example.english: As a child, I would quickly outgrow my shoes and always had to buy a new pair.
example.traditional: 我細路仔嗰陣啲鞋好快就著唔落，成日要買過對。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 lou6 zai2 go2 zan6 di1 haai4 hou2 faai3 zau6 zoek6 m4 lok6 seng4 jat6 jiu3 maai5 gwo3 deoi3
